gaps.lead: His salary is low, but he enjoys his work.
gaps.explanation: …though his salary is low — 'though' links the concession.

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard warned us.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with not + to-infinitive: warned us not to touch.

gaps.sentence: They announced that ___ selling the house.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were selling.
